item.title: Preparations continue for rollout of new public health surveillance platform in nine pilot countries
item.description: Next year’s rollout of Epi+, a multilingual event-based surveillance platform designed to help countries detect and assess emerging public health threats, is coming closer as ECDC and Italy’s Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS) hold training this week for 40 national epidemiologists and technical experts in Rome.
item.dc:creator: ECDC

item.title: From preparedness to response: EU Reference Laboratories for Public Health in action
item.description: Strong laboratory capacity is the backbone of Europe’s preparedness in the face of increasing communicable disease threats, said ECDC on the occasion of today’s European Laboratory Day, celebrated every year on 5 November to recognise the essential contribution of laboratory professionals across Europe.
item.dc:creator: ECDC

item.title: First public health emergency preparedness assessments across Europe show both commitment and recurring challenges
item.description: The first cycle of Public Health Emergency Preparedness Assessments (PHEPAs) coordinated by the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) has shown a strong commitment to emergency preparedness across Europe, with a number of common challenges remaining.
item.dc:creator: ECDC
